docs: add community adapters (Mastra, assistant-ui, ai-effect) (#25059)

## Background

Our Adapters overview only listed the first-party LangChain and
LlamaIndex adapters, though several community packages integrate the AI
SDK with other libraries and frameworks. I looked through vercel/ai
issues and PRs and through X posts mentioning @aisdk for community
adapters that are actively maintained and support AI SDK 7.

- [`@mastra/ai-sdk`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mastra/ai-sdk)
([docs](https://mastra.ai/integrations/agentic-ui/ai-sdk-ui)): streams
Mastra agents, workflows and agent networks as AI SDK UI message streams
(`chatRoute`, `handleChatStream`, `toAISdkStream`). It uses the v7
stream format by default and has a `version: 'v6'` option. About 822k
weekly downloads; last released 2026-11-12. Our docs only mention Mastra
as the first-party `@ai-sdk/harness-mastra` harness.
-
[`@assistant-ui/ai-sdk`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@assistant-ui/ai-sdk)
([docs](https://www.assistant-ui.com/docs/runtimes/ai-sdk/v7)): connects
AI SDK chats to assistant-ui chat components. assistant-ui documents it
as the AI SDK 7 runtime package; `@assistant-ui/react-ai-sdk` now just
re-exports it. Peer dependency `ai@^7.0.101`. About 253k weekly
downloads; last released 2026-11-10.
- [ai-effect](https://ai-effect.fdarian.com/)
([source](https://github.com/fdarian/ai-effect),
[npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ai-effect)): wraps `generateText`,
`streamText`, `tool`, `ToolLoopAgent`, `embed`, `embedMany` and `rerank`
so they return [Effect](https://effect.website/) values, with Effect
`Stream`s, Effect-based callbacks, a typed `AiError`, UI message streams
and tracing. Peer dependencies are `ai@^7` and `effect@^4`. The project
is very new (first published 2026-11-11).

## Summary

Added a "Community Adapters" section to
`content/providers/06-adapters/index.mdx` that lists Mastra,
assistant-ui and ai-effect. It ends with a note inviting PRs for other
community adapters, the same note the Tools page uses.

## Checklist

- [x] All commits are signed (PRs with unsigned commits cannot be
merged)
- [ ] Tests have been added / updated (for bug fixes / features)
- [ ] Documentation has been added / updated (for bug fixes / features)
- [ ] A _patch_ changeset for relevant packages has been added (for bug
fixes / features - run `pnpm changeset` in the project root)
- [x] I have reviewed this pull request (self-review)

chore(provider/gateway): update gateway model settings files (#25104)

Automated update of the gateway model settings files.

Regenerated from the upstream gateway model list by
[`update-model-settings.yml`](https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/main/.github/workflows/update-model-settings.yml)
([this run](https://github.com/vercel/ai/actions/runs/43904857724)).
Merging this PR is what surfaces newly-released gateway models as IDE
autocomplete suggestions when users type a model string with
`@ai-sdk/gateway`.

See the workflow file for details on cadence and scope.
